# Oxide Launcher 1.12.0

## Copper Oxide builds its own renderer

`libcopperoxide.so` is now compiled from source in GitHub Actions (MobileGlues 97558a6 plus Oxide patches) instead of shipping a precompiled binary. The F3 version string reports Copper Oxide; vendor credits, extensions and rendering behavior are unchanged.

## Simpler control editor

The control editor opens in Simple mode with one Advanced switch for snapping, styles, focus and reorder. The default layout is now `emulated/new.json`, with the previous default as fallback.

## New app icon

Launcher icon replaced with the /emulated/icon.png artwork, used 1:1 with no adaptive zoom.
